tests_notes: Isolated and unknown sources, directed reachability, shortest over first-found paths, BFS order with cycles; workload: BFS over a 30×30 grid.

A.strategy: deque queue, distances dict as visited
A.rationale: queue.pop(0) shifts the whole list and `not in visited` scans it: O(V²). deque.popleft and dict membership are O(1); nodes are discovered in the same order, so the dict is identical.

B.rationale: Expands one BFS level at a time, so a node's distance is the level counter and no queue is popped. distances doubles as the visited set; discovery order matches the FIFO queue exactly.

C.rationale: Conservative micro-optimization: popleft on a deque is O(1) where list.pop(0) is O(n). Everything else, including the visited list, is unchanged.

notes: A method on a picklable dataclass. C fixes the obvious pop(0) but not the real cost, the visited-list scan, and measures as no change.
